== Biography ==
The index names William Glasgow and Agnes Steedman, married on 9 Oct 1807 at Ratho, Midlothian, Scotland.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60144/records/674997 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561–1910: William Glasgow and Agnes Steedman, 9 Oct 1807, record 60144/674997].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Another William Glasgow marriage is indexed in Midlothian in this period. The spouse and parish differ; whether the entries concern the same person is unresolved.
